status: registered; single final open pending (hard scene, margin-primary)
motivation: On the hard/occluded sealed final (seed 778) the CNN caution beat the linear probe (G1 pass) but the threshold calibrated to the 10% false-alarm budget did not transfer (realized FPR 0.139 > 0.125 slack, G2 fail). The registered conservative arm (calibrate to 5%) landed at realized FPR 0.079, under the 10% budget. This amendment was written AFTER seeing seed 778, so seed 778 cannot test it; a fresh, never-opened sealed seed (779) is the honest test.

amendment.primary_calibration: Half-budget margin is PRIMARY: each detector's threshold is set on the calibration split's benign steps to false-caution rate <= 0.05 (half of the 0.10 operational budget). The 0.10-calibrated arm is still computed and reported for reference.
amendment.G1: On the sealed final, at the margin-calibrated thresholds: CNN recall > linear-probe recall, CNN AUC-PR > probe AUC-PR, and the 95% bootstrap CI (10,000 resamples over hazard steps) lower bound on recall_cnn - recall_probe > 0.
amendment.G2: CNN realized false-caution rate on the sealed final's benign steps <= 0.10 (the operational budget itself; no extra slack, since the margin is built in).

unchanged: Hard scene (amendment1), model, per-head checkpoint selection, training data (seed 0), calibration data (seed 1), baselines, advisory-only boundary, single-open discipline.
honest_expectation: The margin should hold the budget; recall at the stricter threshold will be lower than at 10% (seed 778 showed CNN 0.302 vs probe 0.157 at the 5% arm). A G1 or G2 failure is reported as-is.
